title: Maximum Nesting Depth of Parentheses

concept.title: The stack size is the depth, and a counter is enough
body: The **nesting depth** at a position is the number of parentheses that are open there. When you push on `(` and pop on `)`, the **size of the stack** is the current depth. If you only need the depth, you do not have to store the brackets: a **counter** does the same job (add 1 on `(`, subtract 1 on `)`).
Other characters (digits, `+`, `*`, ...) are ignored. Whenever a stack would only be used to know its size, think about replacing it by a counter.

statement: A valid arithmetic expression is given without spaces. It contains digits, the operators `+`, `-`, `*`, `/` and the parentheses `(` and `)`, and the parentheses are balanced. Print the largest number of parentheses that are open at the same time.

examples.note: The deepest place is inside ((8): depth 3.

hints: Count how many parentheses are open.
Keep the largest value of the counter.

explanation: The number of open parentheses is kept in a counter; the largest value it reaches is the maximum depth.
